poor.quote: Do I know? Can I know...
all those who laid into my heart, as into their own hiding place, their hopes
All those I cannot get past, who have worn me out...
What is strange in it, if they come once more?
I ate up the news of a row of white sacks with a ripe plum
I simply took, you know, a wonderful juicy plum in my fingers
One after another, a second and a third

good.quote: the door will not swing open... just a little, with a faint creak
whose blood drained out through a small hole from a soldier's bullet
they wrapped you in white sacks, swung you on ropes in the air, and then laid you in poorly covered pits, from which dogs dug you out
Twelve of you... and I yawned.
because horror has sucked all the blood out of me
you walk like a bloody phantom. Pass on! I am tired.
all of them leave on my soul the prints of their soles
